title: AggregationRequest
description: Request schema for initiating a federated model aggregation operation.

modelId.description: Unique identifier of the model family being trained.

baseModelVersion.description: Version number of the immutable base model.

baseModelPath.description: Filesystem path to the baseline model artifact.

newVersion.description: Version number to assign to the newly created aggregated model.

newVersionOutputDirectory.description: Filesystem directory where the new model artifact will be saved.

updates.description: List of trainer updates to include in this aggregation round.

samplesTrained.description: Number of samples trained for this update (used as FedAvg weighting factor).

deltaPath.description: Filesystem path to the serialized delta artifact.
